versions.changelog:
## Added
- The supported model table now lists glm-5.3-flash for text-only requests through Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Gemini contents; image, video and file input are rejected.

## Added
- Document glm-5.3 text and streaming requests through OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions.

## Changed
- Document GLM authentication, request, result verification, and stop boundaries in the primary recipe, with compatibility protocols loaded only when required.

## Changed
- Complete marketplace distribution for the RunAPI GLM skill.

## Added
- Document stable capability and model-limit errors, protocol-visible Usage behavior, reservation-safe output caps, and readiness-gated context limits.

## Changed
- Document terminal support, cull, and native-only decisions for advanced GLM-5.2 capabilities across every caller protocol.

## Added
- Add `glm-5.2` to the supported model list and use it in the primary examples.

## Changed
- Document the initial text-only contract and explicit rejection of deferred advanced fields.

## Changed
- Initial RunAPI skill for GLM chat with OpenAI-compatible defaults and protocol compatibility notes.
